gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an admitted first-slab degree-one case causing undefined integrated-projector formulas and an independently invalid p=1 reconstruction branch. ISSUE-002 concerns finite-regularity rate exponents and does not recognize either missing low-degree case or endpoint reconstruction failure.

The gold defect is that Banach-space hypotheses do not support the L2 and X inner-product operations used to define and prove the integrated operator. ISSUE-002 addresses a regularity-dependent convergence-rate mismatch, with no recognition of the missing Hilbert-space structure.

The gold issue is a false spatial elliptic-projection H1 approximation exponent, demonstrated by a piecewise-linear counterexample. ISSUE-002 discusses different terms and regularity regimes in the hp convergence theorem and does not identify or repair the false elliptic-projection estimate.

The gold defect is that reconstruction inner products and the squared-norm test argument are undefined for a general Banach space, requiring a Hilbert assumption. ISSUE-002 concerns a convergence-rate exponent and does not recognize this hypothesis failure.
